scope: Current HIG topic tree: abstracts, full written primary content including platform tabs, lists, tables and media descriptions/captions; topic/resource/change-log links. Linked videos, SDKs and original visual media were not reviewed in full.
method: Primary agent plus five reading agents; each extracted page read in full, truncated tool outputs supplemented; conclusions in apple-hig-reading.md.
hashMethod: SHA-256: doccObjectSha256 hashes JSON.stringify(parsed official JSON); extractedTextSha256 hashes the exact UTF-8 extraction read by the assigned agent. Digests identify this snapshot, not runtime validation.
